item.title: Tech imports face delays as strike hits Kenya’s Jomo Kenyatta International Airport
item.description: JKIA is a critical hub for time-sensitive tech imports and other cargo imports. Disruptions can ripple across supply chains, delay ICT and electronics, and slow the movement of talent that drive Kenya's digital economy. As the country plans to expand air freight capacity for international trade imports, the strike exposes the manual lever that still throws a wedge in its ambition.
